"""Normalisation of user-supplied lists before they are stored."""


def unique_emails(emails):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for email in emails:
        normalized = email.strip().lower()
        if not normalized:
            continue
        if normalized in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(normalized)
        result.append(normalized)
    result.sort()
    return result


def unique_tags(tags):
    known = set()
    out = []
    for tag in tags:
        cleaned = tag.strip().lower()
        if not cleaned:
            continue
        if cleaned in known:
            continue
        known.add(cleaned)
        out.append(cleaned)
    out.sort()
    return out


def split_tags(text):
    return [part for part in text.replace(";", ",").split(",")]
